operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, while revenue increased by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, so revenue per passenger was broadly stable.
Unit economics for FY2023, the last year with capacity data, showed RASK of {{rask@FY2023}} against CASK of {{cask@FY2023}} and CASK ex-fuel of {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2023}}.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median, which supports the cost base if fuel prices hold.

peer_positioning.text: Gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} is the lowest of the low-cost peer group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), against a median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@2024}}.
FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} is the strongest in the group ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}), well above the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2024}}.

The EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} and net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} both sit in line with the peer medians, ranking {{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2024}} and {{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}} respectively.

Cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} is the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}), below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@2024}}.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the peer group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}), so the buffer against near-term maturities is thinner than at the peers.

Profitability: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} and operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}, so earnings are not keeping pace with revenue, which rose by {{revenue.change@FY2024}}.
Debt: total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, which diluted FFO to debt to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}.
Customer prepayments: contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}} rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is refundable if bookings slow.
